# lunar-python 1.4.8

Source: https://pypi.org/project/lunar-python/1.4.8/
Upstream: https://github.com/6tail/lunar-python
License: MIT (see lunar_python-LICENSE; also included in the archive).

The archive contains unmodified Python source and LICENSE from the PyPI source distribution.
It is imported directly with zipimport on CPython and Pyodide, so no pip installation is needed.
No runtime network request is made to install this dependency.

Source distribution SHA256: `3aa11cc73c25e70ddf0ba5bdac7398c03acc9491a3aa512a91c9642973b669d6`

To update: download the pinned source distribution, retain lunar_python/**/*.py and LICENSE
in a ZIP with lunar_python/ at its root, update app/bazi.py and the Pages asset paths,
then run the calendar boundary and API tests.
